$comment: MDM allowlist manifest for the in-house zoom-private client. Import into your MDM (Intune / Jamf / Workspace ONE) so the client is deployed as a MANAGED app: files delivered by MDM carry no Mark-of-the-Web (Windows) and no com.apple.quarantine flag (macOS), so SmartScreen and Gatekeeper do not prompt.

publisher.name: BetterDesk in-house
publisher.note: Deploy this public certificate to the device trust stores using the scripts in this folder. The private key never leaves the build host.

checksums.$comment: SHA-256 of the published bundles. Regenerate with scripts/trust/mdm/update-checksums.ps1 after each release.
